turns.assessment: The loss is common to every channel on S09→S05 and is already present at the booster input (O33), so the fault lies before amp0 rather than at amp1 or in a downstream span. Unchanged pump currents across all five amplifiers strongly contradict an amplifier pump failure. A hard disconnection of the OMS input patch at S09 best explains the simultaneous loss of booster input, all downstream amplifier powers, OCM channels, and receivers.

proposals.rationale: A disconnected or broken patch between the S09 ROADM degree and the S09→S05 booster would remove all channels at amp0 input and consequently at every downstream amplifier and receiver, exactly matching the hard all-channel loss.
